subject: science
domain: From Molecules to Organisms: Structures and Processes
skillName: Cells as the Unit of Life

items.prompt:
Which statement is part of cell theory?
A) All living things are made of one or more cells
B) Cells are only found in animals
C) All cells are the same size
D) Cells come from nonliving matter
items.answer: A) All living things are made of one or more cells

steps: Cell theory states that all living things are made of cells.

items.prompt:
An organism made of a single cell is called:
A) Multicellular
B) Unicellular
C) Nonliving
D) A tissue

steps: 'Uni' means one, so a one-celled organism is unicellular.

items.prompt:
Which of these is a multicellular organism?
A) A bacterium
B) An amoeba
C) An oak tree
D) A single yeast cell

steps: An oak tree is made of many cells, so it is multicellular.

items.prompt:
According to cell theory, new cells are produced by:
A) Appearing from nonliving material
B) The division of existing cells
C) Mixing air and water
D) Sunlight alone
items.answer: B) The division of existing cells

steps: Cell theory states all cells come from existing cells, which divide to make new ones.

items.prompt:
A student finds a tiny organism that is made of one cell and reproduces on its own. The best conclusion is that it is:
A) Nonliving because it is so small
B) A living, unicellular organism
C) A piece of a larger animal
D) Made of no cells

steps: It is made of a cell and carries out life processes, so it is a living unicellular organism.

items.prompt:
Which is the basic unit of structure and function in living things?
A) The organ
B) The cell
C) The molecule
D) The organism

steps: Cell theory names the cell as the basic unit of life.

items.prompt:
Why can both a one-celled bacterium and a many-celled whale be called living things?
A) Both are large
B) Both are made of cells that carry out life processes
C) Both have the same number of cells
D) Neither is made of cells
items.answer: B) Both are made of cells that carry out life processes

steps: Cell theory says living things are made of one or more cells; the count does not matter.

items.prompt:
A claim states that a jar of sugar water can form new cells by itself. This claim contradicts cell theory because:
A) Sugar is not sweet enough
B) Cells can only come from existing cells
C) Sugar water is alive
D) Cells are not units of life
items.answer: B) Cells can only come from existing cells

steps: Cell theory requires that all cells come from existing cells, not from nonliving mixtures.
